text into chunks of approximately `chunk_size_tokens` tokens\n691\t/// with `chunk_overlap_tokens` overlap between adjacent chunks.\n692\tpub fn chunk_session_text(\n693\t    text: &str,\n694\t    chunk_size_tokens: usize,\n695\t    chunk_overlap_tokens: usize,\n696\t) -> Vec<String> {\n697\t    if text.is_empty() {\n698\t        return Vec::new();\n699\t    }\n700\t\n701\t    // Estimate character count from tokens (roughly 4 chars per token)\n702\t    let chunk_size_chars = chunk_size_tokens * 4;\n703\t    let overlap_chars = chunk_overlap_tokens * 4;\n704\t\n705\t    if text.len() {\n713\t        let end = (start + chunk_size_chars).min(text.len());\n714\t\n715\t        // Find a word boundary near the end\n716\t        let chunk_end = if end < text.len() {\n717\t            text[end..]\n718\t                .find(' ')\n719\t                .map(|offset| end + offset)\n720\t                .unwrap_or(end)\n721\t        } else {\n722\t            end\n723\t b.1.partial_cmp(&a.1).unwrap());\n        results.truncate(k);\n\n        Ok(results)\n    }\n\n    /// Search the chunk-level index\n    ///\n    /// Returns the top-K most similar chunks by cosine
